structured_output.analysis: The best grid is iso_3.15. Its measured KL is 0.4361 (E514ab09c524e), above the predicted 0.3983, so interactions between layers add loss the single-layer sums miss. It uses 3.14795 bits per weight against a budget of 403/128 = 3.1484, which leaves almost no room. Among the loss-concentration layers, every alternative that beats the current method costs more bits, so any upgrade must be paid for by a downgrade. The retrieved records do not show any cheap downgrade candidate. One example: upgrading 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 (0.00633, E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 (0.00181, E90bd4b2f3645) would need about 1 bit per weight of funding. Moving 27.up_proj from gptq_int3 to gptq_int2 would cover it but adds about 0.021 KL (Ec2994e80f2d5 vs Ef04d8aa7bded), which is a net loss. I therefore propose changes to the GPTQ options, which do not change the stored bits. All options are at their defaults (act_order=false, damp=0.01), and the 7 GPTQ methods cover 178 of the 196 cells. The likely benefit of act_order is a prediction, not a measurement.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: No layer changes, so the stored bits match iso_3.15 (KL 0.4361, E514ab09c524e). It sets act_order=true for all GPTQ methods, which currently run with act_order=false. The main loss layers are GPTQ int3 or int2, for example 27.up_proj gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065).

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). It sets act_order=true and lowers damp from 0.01 to 0.005, so the calibration Hessian is followed more closely. The loss layers 3.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 (0.00642, E6f4f7ea296d5) and 2.up_proj gptq_int3 (0.00642, E9baa10763ebe) are GPTQ-quantized.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp02
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). It sets act_order=true and raises damp to 0.02, the other direction from the damp=0.005 grid, to test whether a stronger regularization narrows the gap between the measured KL of 0.4361 and the predicted 0.3983. One example of loss on a 2-bit layer is 18.gate_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447).
